question: Which player has the highest market value (most recent valuation on record)?
answer: Erling Haaland has the highest most recent market value on record: 180000000 (valuation date: 2025-05-29).
sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  pmv.market_value,
  to_timestamp(pmv.date_unix)::date AS valuation_date
FROM (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    date_unix,
    market_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_id
      ORDER BY date_unix DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM player_market_values
) pmv
JOIN players p
  ON p.player_id = pmv.player_id
WHERE pmv.rn = 1
ORDER BY pmv.market_value DESC NULLS LAST, pmv.date_unix DESC NULLS LAST, p.player_id
LIMIT 1;
